info.title: Relio Context API — Target DTO Contract
info.description:
TARGET DRAFT awaiting O1 acknowledgement, based on data-repository-contract-draft.md sections A/B and data-repository-contract-response-o2.md. This document specifies proposed HTTP DTOs, not current runtime business responses. This phase covers context reads only; assessment-backed overview ranking, actions and model endpoints are separate tasks. The facts-list order is not the final scored MVP overview order.

GET /healthz is implemented as liveness only. The existing deal routes are legacy scaffolds: their success branches encode a bare array of models.Deal for the list and a bare models.Deal for detail, not the rich facts/envelopes below. They accept only the fixed 2026-10-01 snapshot (also the default when as_of is absent), not historical reads. Valid scaffold deal reads return 503 while the adapter is unconfigured; existing public codes include invalid_as_of, invalid_deal_id, deal_not_found, deal_data_unavailable and internal_error. Migrating DTOs, temporal validation and error codes requires explicit coordinated implementation.

Graph, timeline and evidence routes, historical projections, server authorization and this target error mapping are planned, not implemented by publishing this document. No database readiness, adapter acceptance or completed acceptance tests are claimed. Business data remains fixed and read-only; this contract does not specify ETL or data fetching. F05 deployment gate/login/provider remains open. No security scheme is finalized here: its omission does not mean resources are public. Target access scope must be derived and enforced server-side, including all references/evidence, and denied resource lookups use generic 404 responses. context_id is correlation, not an authorization token.

x-relio-open-questions: F02/F08: O1 acknowledgement, shared Go types, final contract version/DTO tags, non-fact vocabularies and public error-code mapping remain pending.
F03: Employment source end-date semantics and proposed inclusive-end to half-open normalization need acknowledgement; mixed native timestamp ordering also needs agreement.
F05: Deployment authorization gate/login/provider is not finalized or documented as implemented.

get.description: Implemented liveness response only. A 200 does not establish business-data, database or adapter readiness, or an implemented authorization gate.

TARGET {meta,bounds,items}, ordered by deal_id ascending, containing only authorized deals visible at as_of. Before a deal's creation date it is excluded. Complete empty results use items: [], not an unavailable-data success. Current runtime instead has a bare legacy models.Deal array success branch, fixed-snapshot validation and 503 without an adapter; facts, filters, pagination and historical behavior here await migration.

parameters.name: account_ids
parameters.description: Proposed O1 DealListOptions filter. Repeated query values form the array; filters only narrow server-authorized scope, never grant access. Empty members are invalid.

parameters.name: deal_types
parameters.description: Proposed O1 DealListOptions filter using repeated query values. Filter semantics for unavailable historical facts and the source vocabulary need O1 confirmation; unknown values must not be inferred from current snapshot facts.

200.description: Target deal-facts page, not the current scaffold response.

get.description: TARGET {meta,deal}. Historical projections expose only supported facts at the selected cutoff; current snapshot values are not a complete historical record. A deal before its creation date is not_visible_at_snapshot (404, safely redacted). Current runtime instead has a bare legacy models.Deal success branch, accepts only the fixed snapshot and returns 503 without the adapter. The target DTO and historical behavior are not yet implemented.

200.description: Target deal-facts envelope, not the current scaffold response.

get.description: Planned TARGET {meta,bounds,nodes,edges}; this route is not implemented. Root deal and all claims/references must be visible and authorized in the same snapshot context. Every returned edge must have both endpoints in nodes; an edge that cannot fit is omitted with explicit truncation reasons. Ambiguous participants remain representable with unknowns, rather than selecting a candidate or failing the whole graph. Account-only context stays account-scoped. Focus narrows/supports an event without extending time or access.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Target traversal depth. Invalid bounds are rejected, not clamped.

parameters.name: max_nodes
parameters.description: Target node budget; incomplete results explicitly declare truncation.

parameters.name: max_edges
parameters.description: Target edge budget; it never permits dangling endpoints.

parameters.name: focus_event_id
parameters.description: Optional visible, authorized event linked to this deal or its documented account context. Does not expand cutoff/scope. A lookup requiring one definite reference may yield ambiguous_reference (422); denied or unavailable resource lookups use a safely redacted 404.

200.description: Target bounded graph with explicit completeness metadata.

get.description: Planned TARGET {meta,bounds,events}; this route is not implemented. Filters intersect snapshot/access restrictions. Proposed date-only ordering is (event_at ascending, event_id ascending), with stable keyset pagination; same-day ID order is presentation, not proof of causal or clock order. Native mixed-precision timestamp ordering requires agreement before use. Timeline can contain more events than a bounded graph; authorized references must remain resolvable through focus/filter in the same context. Account-only events are not relabeled as deal-specific. Ambiguous participants stay in DTOs/unknowns, not a blanket 422.

parameters.name: event_ids
parameters.description: Proposed O1 TimelineOptions event-ID filter; repeated query values form the array and can help resolve graph focus. Empty members are invalid.

parameters.name: event_types
parameters.description: Proposed O1 TimelineOptions event-type filter using repeated query values. Source taxonomy remains subject to O1 acknowledgement.

parameters.name: actor_node_ids
parameters.description: Proposed O1 TimelineOptions actor-node filter using repeated query values. Candidate identity is not promoted to a verified actor match.

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Proposed O1 TimelineOptions status filter using repeated query values. Source status normalization and filtering unavailable facts need confirmation; unknown is not rejected or completed.

200.description: Target event page; a complete empty result has events: [].

get.description: Planned TARGET {meta,evidence}; this route is not implemented. Returns one authorized, snapshot-visible claim/field/span, never an entire row or thread. Snapshot-only evidence cannot establish historical facts; future excerpts, replies, key values and references are withheld. A lookup requiring one definite claim/reference may return ambiguous_reference (422), without selecting the first candidate. Denied evidence lookups use generic 404 and disclose no excerpt or existence. Permission for one deal does not authorize other accounts or company-wide evidence.

200.description: Target evidence envelope in the same server-derived snapshot/access context as other panels.

AsOf.name: as_of
AsOf.description: TARGET date-only YYYY-MM-DD selecting the whole calendar day in Asia/Jakarta; maximum accepted date is 2026-10-01. Default 2026-10-01 applies ONLY when the parameter is absent. Explicit empty values, duplicate occurrences (even identical), invalid calendar dates, malformed/date-time values and future dates are rejected with 400, never defaulted or clamped. Event dates must be <= as_of. Native timestamps, if actually available, use the start of the following day exclusively in Asia/Jakarta, not midnight UTC as the end of the selected day. This is event-time projection, not proof of knowledge-time reconstruction. Historical snapshot-only fields remain null with state snapshot_only and limitations, rather than promising all historical fields are known. Current deal scaffolds support only the fixed snapshot; these temporal semantics await implementation.

DealID.name: deal_id
DealID.description: Native deal identifier, distinct from an account ID. Blank/whitespace-only identifiers are invalid; no business-ID example is asserted here.

EvidenceID.name: evidence_id
EvidenceID.description: Stable evidence-unit identifier, not a source business-record ID. Blank/whitespace-only identifiers are invalid.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Target list/timeline page size. Default only when absent; empty, duplicate, malformed and out-of-range scalar values are rejected as invalid_query (400), not clamped.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque target keyset cursor bound to the originating context and query: date, dataset/contract versions, calendar zone, authorized access scope, filters, bounds and stable sort. A changed context/query yields context_mismatch (409); malformed, empty or duplicate scalar cursors yield invalid_query (400). Omit for the first page. Not an authorization token.

BadRequest.description: Target 400 for invalid_snapshot or invalid_query: invalid as_of, malformed parameters, missing/invalid IDs, bounds or filters. Public code mapping is provisional under F08; repository categories are not automatically serialized as public codes.

NotFound.description: Target 404 for not_found or not_visible_at_snapshot. Unauthorized resource lookup also uses the same generic not-found code/message and omits revealing issues; do not disclose existence, hidden scope, future facts or excerpts. Applies to resource/reference lookup, not a complete empty collection. Authorized snapshot invisibility may be distinguished only when safe. Public code mapping remains provisional.

ContextMismatch.description: Target 409 for context_mismatch: cursor context/query differs from the effective snapshot, versions, scope, filters or bounds. Restart pagination in the correct context instead of mixing panels/pages. Public code mapping remains provisional.

AmbiguousReference.description: Target 422 for ambiguous_reference ONLY when the requested lookup requires one definite reference and cannot safely choose one. Representable participant/fact ambiguity is returned as DTO state/unknowns, not a blanket failure. Issues, if present, contain only authorized safe references. Public code mapping remains provisional.

InternalError.description: Target 500 for query_failed or an unexpected internal failure. Sanitized public message only; never expose cause, query text, driver details, credentials or inaccessible source data. Cancellation/deadline handling remains an application concern, not evidence of missing data. Public code mapping remains provisional.

DataNotReady.description: Target 503 for data_not_ready when the adapter, schema, fixed dataset/version or core source integrity is unavailable. Not an empty 200; no request-time import or data fetching. Current valid deal scaffold reads use 503 with deal_data_unavailable while the adapter is unconfigured; this target mapping awaits explicit migration.

Identifier.description: Nonblank stable identifier. Native business IDs and namespaced/derived technical IDs retain their distinct meanings; no illustrative business identifiers are used as audited facts.

IDList.description: Required reference arrays serialize as [], never null. All references must be visible, authorized and resolvable in the same context.

StringList.description: Required arrays serialize as [], never null. Reasons/limitations must not disclose hidden or future values.

Date.description: Valid calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, not a fabricated midnight timestamp. Calendar validity must be checked, not just the pattern.

NullableDate.description: Native/supported calendar date or null; never an empty-string unknown or invented timestamp.

NullableTimestamp.description: Timestamp with offset only when natively available and snapshot-visible. Date-only sources yield null; preparation/request time is not business event, observed or recorded time.

VerificationState.description: O1 proposed verification vocabulary includes verified, inferred and ambiguous. Unresolved/unknown vocabulary needs confirmation; no closed enum is asserted before shared types are agreed. Date validity alone does not verify identity or a claim.

ScopeKind.description: Source scope classification; proposed labels include deal, account and company, with final vocabulary awaiting O1. Account-only claims have no inferred deal IDs. Company scope requires verified classification and explicit permission; unknown scope is not company-wide by default.

FactAvailability.description: Shared OAS 3.1 conditional invariants: known requires a nonnull value and at least one evidence ID; unknown, ambiguous and snapshot_only require null. snapshot_only denotes withholding a snapshot-only value in historical projection, not nulling every fact at the full snapshot: a supported value at that snapshot may be known with temporal_basis snapshot. Missing never becomes zero, an empty string, rejected or a guessed value.

value.description: Exact integer; a known zero is distinct from unavailable null.

reason.description: Snapshot-safe reason; no concealed values or source details.

reference_ids.description: Supporting references or authorized candidates, never hidden identities.

SnapshotMeta.description: Target shared snapshot metadata. Version values must come from the agreed contract and prepared dataset manifest, not fabricated audit/demo versions. Publishing this schema does not establish readiness or historical coverage.

contract_version.description: Consumer-contract revision; this document's draft version is provisional pending O1/F08.

dataset_version.description: Fixed prepared dataset/schema/mapping manifest identity. An unavailable manifest yields data_not_ready, not an invented version.

as_of.description: Effective validated date, no later than max_as_of.

context_id.description: Server-derived correlation of date, dataset/contract versions, calendar zone and authorized scope. All panels must agree; not a bearer token or browser allowlist.

data_state.description: partial requires identified limitations. Unavailable core data/not_ready yields 503 rather than an empty successful business response.

Bounds.description: Target explicit completeness/budget metadata. A complete empty array differs from a truncated result and from unavailable data; bounds are not proof a business fact never existed.

truncated.description: True when pagination or a result budget leaves the result incomplete.

truncation_reasons.description: Explicit safe reasons when truncated; [] for a complete result.

next_cursor.description: Opaque context/query-bound next-page cursor. Null if no next page or pagination is inapplicable; a budget-truncated graph may have no cursor. Not authorization.

DealFacts.description: Target facts DTO, not legacy models.Deal. Structural ID/account linkage is sourced, not a claim all account/deal metadata is historically known. Conflicting critical facts use null/ambiguous rather than silently selecting a value.

owner_id.description: Deal owner, not account owner; historical value is withheld without owner history.

stage.description: Current stage does not reconstruct earlier stages; snapshot-only historical value is null.

stage_since.description: Documented start of the supported stage, not evidence of all earlier stages.

created_at.description: Supported deal creation calendar date; missing stays unknown.

planned_outlets.description: Planned deal outlets, not substituted account active-outlet counts.

potential_acv_idr.description: Exact annual potential value in integer rupiah; not revenue, margin or a computed denominator.

status.description: Source-supported lifecycle status at the cutoff, not retroactive current Won/Lost.

record_evidence_ids.description: Structural linkage provenance, possibly [] in historical projection; each known scalar fact also requires its own evidence.

ParticipantRef.description: Target event-time identity reference. Name/email similarity alone does not merge a person; one candidate is not automatically verified. Unknown/unresolved identity may retain a stable technical locator and authorized raw/candidate references.

node_id.description: Chosen resolved node or null; ambiguous identity has no chosen node.

raw_ref.description: Only snapshot-visible, authorized source reference text.

match_method.description: Source-supported/reviewed identity-linkage method; exact vocabulary awaits O1.

Validity.description: Proposed internal interval [valid_from,valid_to). Source employment end-day interpretation/normalization remains subject to O1 acknowledgement, not asserted as verified source semantics. Future endpoints are masked in historical projection.

valid_from.description: Null start does not mean valid since the beginning of time.

valid_to.description: Exclusive interval end if supported and visible; unknown/open/future-withheld endpoints are null.

open_end_reason.description: Safe explanation distinguishing open/unknown/withheld endpoints without revealing future dates.

node_id.description: Stable namespaced graph identifier, not a query-order counter.

node_type.description: Proposed O1 domain types include Deal, Account, Person, Interaction, Event, Decision, ActionOccurrence, Evidence, Contract, UsageAggregate and optional Outlet; never a database-driver type.

entity_id.description: Native entity ID or stable sourced locator, distinct from node_id.

person_kind.description: Employee/contact/unresolved classification when applicable; final vocabulary awaits O1.

label.description: Sourced snapshot-safe name/title; current labels cannot be invented as historical names.

Edge.description: Target sourced typed relation; both source and target node IDs must be present in the returned graph. Verification/matching must hold at the relevant business time, and an inferred link is not an approval or permission.

edge_type.description: O1 domain relation vocabulary and endpoint constraints, not driver metadata.

Event.description: Target stable sourced event visible at or before as_of. Later status/outcome claims and future replies are not folded into an earlier event. Native date-only events get no fictional clock time.

time_precision.description: date for date-only sources; additional native timestamp precision vocabulary awaits agreement.

event_type.description: Source-backed/reviewed O1 category; do not create events merely to fill menu categories.

status.description: Supported claim status, with unknown distinct from rejected/completed; normalization vocabulary is provisional.

raw_status.description: Authorized snapshot-visible source status, retained separately from normalization.

summary.description: Evidence-backed reviewed summary, not automatic model output or future outcome.

deal_ids.description: Account-only events retain []; shared account alone does not invent deal linkage.

SourceSpan.description: Zero-based Unicode-code-point [start,end) offsets into the original source field, not byte offsets. Server validates end >= start, field bounds and checksum; JSON Schema does not compare sibling numeric values.

Evidence.description: Target single field/claim/span provenance, not an entire source row/thread. All contents, composite-key parts and linked IDs are snapshot/access-safe. Deterministic source locators and checksums are prepared by O1, never reconstructed by fetching/parsing source data during a request.

source_file.description: Authorized logical source filename, not an internal filesystem path.

source_record_id.description: Exact native record ID or stable derived locator, not a query-order counter or fabricated business ID.

source_key.description: Only authorized, visible key parts; may be {} when a full composite key would leak future/hidden values. Internal resolver keys are not exposed.

source_checksum.description: Prepared fixed-source checksum; this draft supplies no invented manifest values.

source_field.description: Actual source column/key for this claim.

span.description: Null for scalar fields that need no excerpt span.

content_excerpt.description: Exact short authorized excerpt/value for one visible claim; not future replies, hidden outcomes or a full thread.

deal_ids.description: [] for account-only claims unless explicit sourced deal linkage exists.

GraphResponse.description: Returned counts must respect requested budgets as well as these maximum caps. Node/edge IDs are stable and edge endpoints are checked against returned nodes; cross-reference consistency is a runtime/acceptance obligation, not enforced by this schema alone.

LookupIssue.description: Optional safe issue detail only for references the caller may see. Never expose concealed resource existence, candidates, source/query details or internal causes.

code.description: Sanitized public category, not an internal error/cause string.

ErrorResponse.description: Target public error DTO. Only code, safe message and optional authorized issues are serialized; no cause, query, credential, driver details or hidden source fields. Final public codes require F08 agreement and explicit migration from scaffold codes; x-relio-error-categories on responses describe repository categories, not a finalized public-code enum.

message.description: Sanitized public explanation; resource-denial lookups use the same generic not-found wording as missing resources.

issues.description: Optional, safe and authorized only; omit when details would reveal a concealed lookup.

HealthResponse.description: Matches the existing liveness DTO, not business-data/database readiness or an acceptance-test result.
